/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
baseline=Path('reviewed.json')
before=baseline.read_bytes()
m=json.loads(before)
root=Path('payload')
actual={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
expected=m['files']
for name in sorted(set(expected)|set(actual)):
    if name not in actual: status='REMOVED'
    elif name not in expected: status='ADDED'
    elif expected[name]"'!=actual[name]: status='"'MODIFIED'
    else: status='UNCHANGED'
    print(json.dumps({'path':name,'status':status,'reviewed_sha256':expected.get(name),'payload_sha256':actual.get(name)}))
print('Baseline file_count:',m['file_count'],'; entries:',len(expected),'; payload files:',len(actual))
print('Baseline SHA-256:',hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest())
assert baseline.read_bytes()==before
PY"
